instructions.question: Would {img} look out of place as the accent shape for `wallpaper` because it evokes a different world than the wallpaper does?
instructions.focus: Judge what the shape evokes: pixels and screens, technology, nature, ornament, toys. Do not judge whether its outline matches forms in the wallpaper. A plain geometric shape evokes no particular world.

true.what: The shape clearly evokes a world the wallpaper does not
examples: A stepped pixel or 8-bit shape on a natural landscape
A pixel shape on a classical oil painting
A leafy organic shape on a circuit-board or code screenshot

false.what: The shape is neutral, or evokes the same world as the wallpaper
examples: A simple geometric shape on any photo
A pixel shape on a retro video game scene
A flower or leaf shape on a garden photo
